title: EOPF Sentinel-2 L2A (unconsolidated Zarr V2), one pinned band group
description:
EOPF (ESA/EODC) Sentinel-2 L2A collection "sentinel-2-l2a" (Zarr V2, unconsolidated, no overviews -- the older, pre-GeoZarr EOPF layout, distinct from eopf-s2-l2a-zarr3's V3/multiscales collection). The collection rotates its items; this fixture pins a current one, S2C_MSIL2A_20261105T105221_N0513_R051_T33WWN_20261105T121505 (datetime 2026-11-05T10:52:21Z, UTM zone EPSG:32633), fetched from `/collections/sentinel-2-l2a/items?limit=1` on build. The `SR_10m` asset is the 10 m reflectance group itself (bands B02/B03/B04/B08), declared by the item with media type `application/vnd+zarr` exactly as published -- a non-standard but real value, kept as-is rather than corrected to `application/vnd.zarr`. No multiscales/overviews exist at this level, so the browser must read full-resolution native pixels at every zoom.

License: ESA/Copernicus Sentinel Data Legal Notice; declared "proprietary".

Expected browser outcome: refused or held back by the zoom/no-overviews guard -- there is no coarser level to fall back to, so either it is refused outright or held back to a high minimum zoom.
